title: Add shop banner and logo from uploaded images

requirements.text: Replace the existing hero banner on the homepage with the uploaded shop banner image (IMG_20251019_102908.png) showing the store interior, logo, Aadhar enabled payment system, stationery availability, and contact number

quotes: Can You Add A Banner Of My Shop And Logo I Am Giving You

acceptanceCriteria: The shop banner image (IMG_20251019_102908.png) is displayed prominently at the top of the homepage
The banner maintains its aspect ratio and is responsive across different screen sizes
The banner replaces any existing hero/banner section on the homepage

requirements.text: Replace the store logo in the header navigation with the uploaded circular logo image (Gemini_Generated_Image_rjk9furjk9furjk9.png) featuring the shopkeeper illustration and 'Maa Bhawani General Store' text in Hindi

quotes: Can You Add A Banner Of My Shop And Logo I Am Giving You

acceptanceCriteria: The circular logo image (Gemini_Generated_Image_rjk9furjk9furjk9.png) appears in the header navigation
The logo is appropriately sized and maintains its circular shape
The logo links to the homepage when clicked
The logo is visible on all pages of the application

requirements.text: Store both uploaded images as static assets in the frontend/public/assets directory with descriptive filenames (shop-banner.png and store-logo.png) for easy reference and maintenance
acceptanceCriteria: Both images are saved in frontend/public/assets directory
Images are referenced using their static asset paths in the application
Images load correctly without any broken image links

constraints: Use the exact uploaded images without modification or regeneration
Maintain the existing header and homepage component structure
Ensure images are optimized for web performance
nonGoals: Modifying the uploaded images in any way
Changing the overall layout or structure beyond banner and logo replacement
Adding new branding elements beyond the provided banner and logo
